messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Prior choice
parts:
Parameters need to be chosen based on what you know about
the parameters. So just seeing your parameter declarations
isn't enough to make concrete recommendations. Also,
I'd skip doc that just duplicates what the code says. It'll
get out of synch and just confuse people.

Usually, we don't recommend those interval-constrained priors
unless there's something physical constraining values into
those intervals. Instead, we prefer softer constraints that
concentrates prior probability mass in the intervals where you
think it should be.

Usually Stan doesn't require hand-done initialization, so
I'd try it without providing hand-tuned initialization to begin.

- Bob
